notes.title: A Christmas Movie Bingo to make your days merry and bright!
notes.content:
Christmas Movie Bingo is finally here!  And just in time for so many Christmas movies.  Everywhere you look, streaming services are serving them up, and this game is here to deliver.

If you plan on doing this game in-person, I recommend setting the game up on a laptop next to the TV, so that everyone can see the bingo situation in real-time, on a smaller screen.  Or if you're streaming over a video chat, run the screenshare of the game on your screen while you watch the actual Christmas movie on your standard platform.

While this game is designed for Christmas movies, if you want an intense, fast-paced game, I recommend pulling up your favorite TV show's Christmas episode.  I played a round this week watching Friends, and someone got a bingo in 4 minutes.

If you give the game a try, I'd love to know what you think and where the game can be improved!  I plan to keep making things better for a long time since this has already become an annual tradition for my friends and family.

Merry Christmas!
-Jaime
